sections.title: Who is responsible
sections.text: Artan.live is operated by Artan Davoodi (legal name: Saeed Davoodi), based in Croatia. For privacy questions, contact davoodi@artan.live.

sections.title: Visiting and preferences
sections.text: The hosting service processes connection information, including IP addresses, to deliver and protect the website. Browser storage supports appearance preferences. You can remove stored website data using your browser settings. External project and social links open services with their own privacy notices.

sections.title: Enquiries
sections.text: If you email the operator, your address and message are used to respond and manage the conversation. Email providers process messages for delivery. Enquiry records are kept while needed for the conversation, related obligations or disputes, then deleted when no longer needed. Please send only information relevant to your enquiry.

sections.title: Purposes and rights
sections.text: Website delivery and security rely on legitimate interests in operating a reliable public portfolio. Replies to enquiries rely on taking steps at your request or legitimate interests in correspondence, depending on the request. You can request access, correction, deletion, restriction, objection or portability where applicable by contacting davoodi@artan.live. Identity checks and legal exceptions may apply. You may also contact Croatia's data-protection authority, AZOP. Mandatory rights under applicable law are not waived by this notice.
